subject.title: Add accessibility config option to disable emojis and unicode symbols in TUI

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent plain-text TUI presentation mode, and should activation live under `tui` config or a startup-only control?
rationale: The accessibility need, implementation boundary, and dependency support are established, but the durable public control and exact replacement vocabulary are product decisions.

options.title: Add `tui` accessibility mode
options.body: Add one documented terminal UI mode and route every decorative symbol through its presentation profile.

options.title: Use startup-only control
options.body: Expose a TUI flag or standard terminal capability without adding persisted configuration.

options.title: Decline built-in mode
options.body: Select and document another first-party screen-reader interface as the supported accessibility path.

recommendation.title: Add `tui` accessibility mode
recommendation.body: Add one documented terminal UI mode and route every decorative symbol through its presentation profile.

likelyOwner.reason: Feature-introduction and current-area history most strongly connect this person to the complete TUI, config, theme, and tool-display decision surface.
